stories.title: Ocultar declaraciones de funcionarios abre puerta a la corrupción: Sistema Nacional de Anticorrupción; “eliminación de organismos desarma a ciudadanos”, dice

en.title: Hiding officials' declarations opens door to corruption: National Anti-Corruption System; "elimination of agencies disarms citizens", it says
en.summary: Mexico's National Anti-Corruption System warns that concealing public officials' financial declarations enables corruption and weakens citizens' ability to demand government accountability, leaving anti-corruption decisions to political authorities.

en.title: "We don't know if our children are alive"; collective formed after young people disappeared in Tamaulipas
en.summary: Family members of disappeared young people in Tamaulipas have organized a collective to search for their missing relatives.
